caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with three glass-paneled doors, framed in a rich reddish-brown color, each door featuring a geometric lattice of diamond-shaped mullions. The cabinet has two prominent, vertically-oriented cylindrical columns at either end, decorated with a series of carved, circular, and leaf motifs. The glass panels display a grid of outlined diamond patterns formed by thin wooden divisions. The cabinet stands on four short, carved feet with a claw-like appearance. At the bottom left, there is a smaller, monochrome diagram showing the cabinet’s front and side elevations with dimensions, and labeled "SCALE: 1 IN." and “MEYERS.” The drawing is composed on a beige background with both color and line-work rendered in a detailed and precise style.
title: China Closet
